card.name: Just before metabolism or clearance words
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name, or a small linking word, right before the next word is expected to be metabolism, elimination or clearance. It appears in drug interaction text about enzyme inhibition.

modes.label: End of drug name
modes.description: Final piece of a drug name, followed by metabolism or elimination.

modes.label: Linking word before clearance
modes.description: A small word such as for, the or and after a drug or enzyme, where clearance comes next.
